notablePrerequisites:
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Clever Conjurer.
description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, coping Clever Conjurer' ability, targetting the mana-producing permanent.
Resolve both Clever Conjurer abilities, untapping Halo Fountain and the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Halo Fountain's first ability by paying {W}, tapping it and untapping Clever Conjurer, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
Repeat.
